description: scripts/check_module_budgets.py currently emits only a soft notice when holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json references a missing/deleted file path, allowing stale or broken override entries to linger in config without failing CI.
goal: Update scripts/check_module_budgets.py so evaluate_budgets() fails immediately with an error (exit code 1) whenever holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json lists an override path that is not an active source module (missing or deleted file), and continues flagging overrides whose actual line count is at or below default_max_lines as stale override notices (with an optional --fail-on-stale-overrides CLI flag / fail_on_stale parameter defaulting to False so existing repository budgets stay green until pruned under maintainer authorisation). Update existing unit tests in tests/test_module_budgets.py to verify that missing/deleted override paths cause evaluate_budgets and main() to fail (exit 1) and that overrides at or below default_max_lines are flagged as stale (and fail when fail_on_stale=True / --fail-on-stale-overrides is passed). Do NOT modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json and create zero new Python files. Keep scripts/check_module_budgets.py strictly within its 200-line budget. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Failing closed on missing/deleted module budget overrides and exposing strict stale-override enforcement prevents budget drift without requiring unauthorised edits to module_budgets.json.
acceptance_criteria: `scripts/check_module_budgets.py` fails immediately if `holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json` names a missing/deleted path and flags stale overrides at or below `default_max_lines`.
`uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint` pass with zero docstrings or comments.

All changes remain within scripts/check_module_budgets.py (<= 200 lines) and tests/test_module_budgets.py, holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is untouched, and zero new Python files are created.
